[[File:Dead_Forest_Entrance_2.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The entrance to the Dead Forest area of the Kkowir Forest]]
Literally meaning "'''[[Dead Forest (Kashyyyk)|Dead Forest]]'''" in the [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Wookiee tongue]], '''Kkowir Forest''' was an area on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], and home to the [[Kerritamba Village|local Kerritamba tribe]] of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], the [[Outcasts (Kashyyyk)|Outcasts]], and the mysterious [[Sayormi]] cult. The [[Myyydril Caverns/Legends|Myyydril Caverns]] lay in the northern parts of the [[Forest/Legends|forest]].

==General information==
[[File:Kkowir_Gate.jpg|thumb|left|225px|The gate leading into and out of the forest]]

The Kkowir Forest was home to the [[Kerritamba Village|Kerritamba Tribe's]] village, a village set up by the Kerritamba. The Kerritamba Village and tribe was led by Chief Kerritamba. Many dangers lay in the Kkowir Forest, including the [[Sayormi]], who were believed to be ghosts that lived in the lower levels of the forest, and [[Wyyyschokk/Legends|webweavers]], a huge, nonsentient arachnid species. The Dead Forest area was one of the most dangerous areas in the forest. Many Sayormi settled there.

===Points of interest===
A few places in the forest interested explorers and dared them to travel further into the forest. The [[Mysess Glade]] was where the [[Great Tree (Kashyyyk)|Great Tree]] was located. The Myyydril Caverns was where the [[Myyydril]] Tribe, a tribe of Wookiees, made a small village. Another area was the [[Kerritamba Village Arena]], just across from the [[Kerritamba Village]].

===Location===
The Kkowir Forest was just northwest of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. [[Dead Guard]]s protected the gate. Although the forest gate was not hard to get to, people feared what lay beyond the gate.

==Forest life==
===Animal life===
In the forest were many types of animals, such as the [[uller]]. Webweavers, a huge, arachnid species, lived inside and outside the ShadowWeave Caverns. [[Urnsor'is]] could be found in caves in the forest. Shadevale Venomsting were in the rivers that flowed through the forest, and on land next to the river.

===Plant life===
[[Mysess blossom/Legends|Mysess blossoms]] were fairly common in the forest, and there were many tall trees. Dead stumps of trees were in the [[Dead Forest (Kashyyyk)|Dead Forest]] area.

==Behind the scenes==
The Kkowir Forest appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
